positive_triggers: A selected idea, audit candidate, feature, migration, architecture change, policy direction, or product direction remains underspecified
Several plausible designs need evidence-based comparison before implementation planning
Requirements, invalid states, ownership, migration, verification, rollout, rollback, or observability remain unresolved
negative_triggers: Generating implementation tickets or delivery plans from an already approved design
Implementing code or repairing the system
Verifying completed implementation without reshaping the approved contract
preconditions: Repository or product scope is known
A human decision owner is named before final approval
applicability.confidence_or_escalation_rule: Proceed with evidence collection and draft analysis under explicit assumptions, but stop approval when a critical unresolved question, missing owner, permission boundary, or required durable destination cannot be resolved.

steps: Proposal, delta specification, design, and rollout drafting
branches: Use wayfinding or explorer lanes when repository scope is too large for one pass
Use prototypes only to answer named uncertainties and discard or quarantine them afterward
Use repository OpenSpec and Spec Kit conventions when present or explicitly required; otherwise create an unsynchronized review bundle in the repository's approved documentation area
Compare multiple designs only while consequential alternatives remain plausible
authoritative_sources: Active OpenSpec changes and relevant tickets

success_conditions: The human decision owner approves requirements, architecture direction, migration direction, rollout, rollback, non-goals, and accepted risks
The proposal, delta specifications, design, decisions, walking skeleton, rollout contract, observability, readiness verdict, deferred items, and handoff are coherent and durable
Another delivery agent can proceed without inventing requirements
failure_conditions: The selected direction is not actually selected
Critical evidence or required repository access is unavailable
A critical decision has no human owner
The requested output requires implementation, ticket generation, PR actions, or production changes
stop_conditions: Implementation is requested under this skill
A prototype would cross into production code
Repository evidence contradicts the selected direction and the owner has not resolved the conflict
Critical requirements remain untestable or rollback claims remain unsupported
rollback_or_recovery: Preserve drafts and ledgers with status DRAFT or BLOCKED
Record the exact missing evidence, owner, decision, or permission needed to resume
Discard or quarantine throwaway prototype artifacts
Do not mark the contract approved until the human approval record exists

inputs: Required destination system such as OpenSpec, Spec Kit, tickets, or another system
outputs: Canonical glossary updates and domain model
artifacts: Repository-native OpenSpec artifacts when available or required
A review bundle based on assets/approved-design-rollout-contract.md when no native structure is available
side_effects: May write design documentation and approved durable change records within the stated scope
May create throwaway prototypes only when explicitly permitted
Does not modify production code, generate delivery tasks, or perform external publication
